VI.description: Sets one control of a VI in memory that holds a NAMED session - an IVI or VISA session, a DAQmx task - to the session of a given name. LabVIEW's ActiveX server takes no value for such a control (SetControlValue answers no error and changes nothing), so this reads the control's own type with Ctrl Val.Get, builds the value from the flattened name and sets it with Ctrl Val.Set. The target must be held open by the caller, so Open VI Reference by path reaches the same VI.
